description: The initiative is positioned as the next phase of the state's broader digital transformation strategy and is aligned with key policy frameworks covering IT/ITeS, startups, industrial development, MSMEs, and renewable energy, according to a release.
body_lead: New Delhi [India], February 20 (ANI): Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav has announced that the state will soon roll out a comprehensive State AI Mission aimed at transforming governance, public services, and economic growth through responsible and large-scale adoption of artificial intelligence at the AI Impact Summit in the national capital.
